vb_textbox.text: There are two colour groupings, Pink and Grey + Purple and Brown. At any given time, one colour from each group will be worth more money.I've found that Pink and Purple or Grey and Brown will be worth more at the same time, but I'm not 100 percent sure on that last bit.As time goes on the colours that are worth more will switch from one colour per group to the other so be sure to experiment once the points start dipping from a colour.
